description: Price one condition for the estimate — the canvas Estimate panel's row. unit is what the condition is bought in (SF, SY, LF, EA); material and labor are $ per that unit: material is priced on the ORDER quantity (waste applied — SY is the waste-adjusted SY), labor on the MEASURED quantity (no waste); EA carries no waste on either. materials prices the condition's supporting-material rows (from edit_materials) per THEIR unit (bag, pail, roll) — quantities are already whole packages. null clears a price back to "not entered"; 0 is an explicit $0 (owner-furnished material, labor-only scope). Every price comes from the estimator or a document they gave you — never invent, estimate or 'typical' one; a price nobody entered stays unentered and estimate_summary names it. The reply carries the condition's estimate line. Rides export_takeoff into the app; undo_last reverses the call.

condition.description: Finish tag of an existing condition, e.g. 'CPT-1'

labor.description: Labor $ per unit, on the measured quantity; null clears

material.description: Material $ per unit, on the order quantity; null clears

materials.description: Prices for the condition's supporting-material rows

name.description: A supporting-material row's name on this condition (case-insensitive)

price.description: $ per the row's own unit; null clears

unit.description: Pricing unit (default: what was measured — area, then length, then count)

name: set_pricing

labor_qty.description: Measured quantity in the unit — no waste

material_qty.description: Order quantity in the unit — waste applied (EA never carries waste)

line.description: The condition's estimate line after this write; null while it has no committed shapes

pricing.description: The condition's prices after this write; an absent field is not entered
